scope: Actual six SVG icons used in polished figures; originals unchanged and adaptations recorded.
notes: Assets are unchanged copies from pinned upstream commits; local file names are aliases.
Bioicons lists licenses per icon. Its root repository license does not override per-icon licenses.
The rat asset is CC-BY-3.0 at the pinned Bioicons version. It has not been relabeled CC-BY-4.0.
The full upstream MIT notice for the two Tabler files is included in assets/LICENSE_TABLER.txt.
The source art is attributed to its upstream creators, not to the manuscript author.
Record any subsequent visual modifications and preserve the applicable attribution and license link.
